name: Ethena USDtb
oneLiner: USDtb is Ethena's T-Bill-backed stablecoin, holding BlackRock's BUIDL fund as primary reserves; designed as a calmer alternative to USDe.
collateral: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL) and cash; August 31, 2026 examined reserves comprised $525,205,527 BUIDL and $5,214,126 demand deposits at FDIC-insured institutions, including $4,964,126 above insurance limits. Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. issues USDtb and holds reserves in unencumbered segregated fiduciary trust accounts for token holders; BUIDL is self-custodied in segregated wallets.
pegMechanism: Customer-gated mint and redemption at $1 par, net of applicable fees; BUIDL is redeemable at NAV through Securitize on a daily basis; LayerZero OFT cross-chain transfers
